limits: Native held-out image labels, merged region-shard identity and exact CLIP crop windows verified. Recomputes annotation grounding and macro metrics of all saved top-five region selections. Does not recompute model responses or verify model-score ranking. Annotation-supported proxy rather than manual semantic judgments; fixed GDINO test-pool geometry can favor GDINO. Compare paired within-bank results, not absolute performance across different attribute/query cohorts.
